Confirms Zapier Free = 100 tasks, 5 single-step Zaps on free tier. Note: this source claims Filter/Formatter included — matches our official pricing fetch.

factcheck.claim: Zapier Free gives 100 tasks per month, with a two-step Zap limit (Filter and Formatter included; Paths excluded)
Make Free gives 1,000 operations/month, 2 active scenarios, and a 15-minute minimum scheduling interval
Make bills 1 operation per scheduled polling trigger check even when no new data is returned; a 15-minute poll burns 2,880 ops/month
Zapier Professional entry price is $19.99/mo billed annually (750 tasks), $29.99/mo billed monthly
Make Core entry price is $9/mo billed annually for 10,000 operations (around $10.59/mo billed monthly)
A Zapier task counts only on successful action steps; triggers, Filter/Paths-skipped steps, and errored/halted steps do not count

own_evidence.proof: A scenario on a 15-minute interval runs 4 times per hour × 24 hours × 30 days = 2,880 trigger ops per month before processing a single update.

own_evidence.desc: Compiled an 8-criterion side-by-side matrix from the two official pricing pages plus six competitor posts, scoring Zapier and Make per row with the published number as the tie-breaker
